verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an AI-native game engine, but the evidence describes no product-provided background or scheduled automations. What it does describe is user-brought agents (Claude Code, Codex) calling Summer's MCP/CLI tools on demand, such as running the publishing flow or reading analytics. Those are interactive, externally driven agent sessions, not recurring or autonomous jobs. Summer hosting game servers is infrastructure, not user automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
